articles.title: BlackRock and Fidelity are quietly turning bitcoin ETFs into a two-firm market
articles.snippet: BlackRock's IBIT and Fidelity's FBTC are attracting the vast majority of new bitcoin ETF money, leaving smaller funds increasingly sidelined as institutional investors consolidate around the industry's largest players.

articles.title: Hungary to reverse crypto trading crackdown after EU scrutiny
articles.snippet: Hungary’s government said it will unwind crypto trading restrictions that required approved validation for conversions and exposed users and service providers to criminal liability.

articles.title: AI models led to a ‘vulnerability apocalypse’ in crypto security: Immunefi CEO
articles.snippet: The proliferation of new frontier AI models is the main catalyst behind the latest resurgence in DeFi hacks, according to Immunefi CEO Mitchell Amador.

articles.title: XRP transaction demand falls 91.5% as traders focus on $0.65 support
articles.snippet: XRP network activity and investor profitability fall to record lows, leading traders to focus on the $1 to $0.65 zone.

articles.title: AI deepfake election ad in Minnesota raises transparency concerns
articles.snippet: A deepfake campaign attack ad in the US state of Minnesota has raised questions around the ethics of using AI in political ads and the regulations surround AI use.
